scope: Read-only source/design study; no builds/Cargo/QEMU/USB or repo changes by reviewer. Subsequent implementation requires root design authorization. No final architecture accepted on user behalf.

current_facts.fact: Allowed legacy UIDs share all approved legacy device pools. There is no broker role or per-user device ownership boundary yet.

Existing root config/helper socket checks validate protected ancestors, NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK open and fstat, bounded64KiB JSON, SO_PEERCRED root identity. Reuse the pattern, not its assumption that every server peer UID is root.
Low-level TLS accepts memory DER, intentionally does not load trusted credential files or open listeners/devices. Preserve those APIs.
Existing ordinary server obtains helper whole-device FDs then owns cleanup/Finish; SIGINT/SIGTERM preparation and output cleanup must remain intact.
Plain listener ServerConfig requires trusted_network for nonloopback; TLS setup must not pretend that declaration is proof of TLS.

server_fields.broker_uid: nonzero u32, exact actual service UID
server_fields.tls: TlsServer with root-defined principals; every principal device must belong to devices pool

client_fields.broker_uid: nonzero u32, exact actual service UID
client_fields.server_id: 1..64 ASCII alias matching helper secure_imports root policy
client_fields.endpoint: core::Peer (validated Host and nonzero port), preserves DNS/IPv4/IPv6
client_fields.server_name: explicit bounded DNS/IP PKI name independent of resolved endpoint

minimal_api.parsing: deny_unknown_fields, schema exactly1, fixed bounds, duplicates rejected; core key errors mapped to fixed transport context. No PEM/environment/CLI credential override or generic config framework.
minimal_api.call_boundary: Synchronous loader in root CLI spawn_blocking; load and verify identity before listener or helper/USB actions. Return immutable loaded TLS objects, no private DER or raw config Debug.
minimal_api.namespace: Loader may carry typed mixed pool; current CLI must require every key matches chosen backend before helper actions, never silently filter.

required: Dedicated nonroot broker UID must differ from interactive allowed_uids. New helper secure action checks the real UDS peer role.
Secure device pool and IDs obtainable through legacy Export/OpenPhysical must be disjoint or corresponding legacy actions denied.
Do not set trusted_network=true to pass old helper or listener checks; new typed secure action applies its own root role policy.

Same broker UID is one trusted OS domain. A subcommand name or executable hash cannot prove another process with that UID cannot act. Use dedicated nonlogin service account and root-managed config/ancestors; root remains trusted.

Client private keys belong to broker service, not interactive CLI. An interactive frontend must use peer-credential-authenticated local broker IPC with fixed remote/operation inputs, not self-reported principal/key paths.

trusted_file_rules: Absolute paths, no parent traversal/symlink ancestors; root-owned and no group/other writable parent chain.
Config and public DER root-owned regular single-link files, no group/other write; config<=64KiB, certificate<=16KiB each and existing total/count caps.

Key owner root or exact broker UID, private0600 (or stricter owner-readable permissions as agreed), no group/other bits; root-protected parents, regular single-link, <=16KiB. root0600 unreadable to broker fails without chown/elevation.
Precheck regular type/metadata, NOFOLLOW|CLOEXEC|NONBLOCK open, compare fstat dev/inode/type/owner/mode; bounded max+1 read and error if oversized/changed. No FIFO/device reads.
Static credential/config stage+IO kind errors; do not log raw JSON, DER/key, unknown-field values, secret content or loaded object Debug. Startup snapshots only; rotation by controlled restart.
protocol_and_auth_risk: Standard DEVLIST RemoteDevice does not contain stable DeviceKey. Authenticated bounded metadata must bind key to the selected BusID/current server slot; do not choose first device or infer from VIDPID. Root/I/H subsequently chose4B length+<=4KiB catalog/import prefix for this purpose.
DEVLIST filtering and IMPORT authorization need the same exact predicate, with the latter checked atomically in fixed backend slot.
Native exported state has dynamic cfg/IF; helper generation must retain strong fixed receipt and handle actual kernel ownership, not blindly trust BusID or config snapshot.
Legacy reachable usbipd/plain listeners remain bypass risks; disabling/isolation and actual IPv4/IPv6 evidence are required. Root can intentionally undermine service policy and remains trusted.
necessary_tests: Actual file fixtures: unknown schema/fields, UID mismatch/zero, pool duplicates/subset errors, malformed key/DER, oversized and growing regular files.
Symlink/hardlink/FIFO/nonregular/groupwrite-parent/wrongowner/public-key-mode refusal; use test-only fixture trust root without weakening production ancestors.
Static error/Debug secret marker checks and ordinary nonbroker refusal before listener/helper action.
Helper role negatives: interactive UID denied secure FD, broker UID denied inappropriate legacy bypass, secure IDs inaccessible through old paths.
Keep actual TLS negative/flush/permit tests; end-to-end encrypted USB and PCAP/IPv4/IPv6 require separate acceptance.
implementation_edges: Transport existing core/serde/serde_json/rustix dependency edges only; no new package or empty crate.
Root moves DeviceKey/VirtualProfile to core with serde/FromStr; transport reexports preserve public paths.
Owned implementation later: transport config.rs/tests/lib.rs/Cargo.toml; root owns CLI and workspace; H owns helper/FD roles.
